headline: Property monitoring reports, farmland lease bid status, and trees of heaven treatment update.
summary: The commission will review property monitoring reports for sites including Fresh Meadows and Beseck Meadow, get a bid status update on the Farmland Lease Properties Program, and discuss trees of heaven treatment. The commission will also meet in executive session to discuss lease, sale, or purchase of real estate.

Property monitoring reports: Fresh Meadows (J. Borne), Beseck Meadow (M. Miller), 1254 Whirlwind Hill Rd. (J. Pyskaty), 205 Main St, Yalesville (B. Conroy), Marcus Cooke (E. Severson)
Farmland Lease Properties Program bid status update from staff
Trails Work Group reports and other correspondence
Executive session on lease, sale, or purchase of real estate under CGS §1-200(6)(D)
Next meeting set for November 12, 2026, 6 p.m.
